tools.name: license_requirements
tools.description: Return source-linked rules only for supported Texas electrician and UK SIA licence types; unsupported jurisdictions remain explicitly unsupported. Price $0.01 USDC. POST /api/v1/license/requirements. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: license_renewal-plan
tools.description: Calculate a renewal checklist and PDF from verified rules and caller-supplied expiry/CE data. Unsupported combinations remain unsupported. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/license/renewal-plan. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: license_deadline-watch
tools.description: Return reminder dates from a caller-supplied expiry date. This is data only; BRAINIAC.software does not send notifications. Price $0.01 USDC. POST /api/v1/license/deadline-watch. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.
